fit.gap_handling_summary: The CV makes a credible junior application rather than fabricating the required professional tenure or backend employment. Accessibility, project-level full-stack work, unit testing, Storybook and teaching are well evidenced. End-to-end testing, production backend depth, health-data privacy and the remote-country restriction remain unresolved; the letter could acknowledge the junior-level fit and express a truthful learning interest more directly.

issues: Although two pages is within normal limits, the second page is only 17.4% filled and begins with a continuation of the education section.
Tidewatch is described extensively under Projects and then repeated under Education.
The teaching-assistant institution is not established by the source material.
Git/GitHub is listed, but no workflow example is provided.

reasons: Single-column extraction is coherent, with intact words, conventional headings and clear dates.
Core React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL and testing terms are prominent.
SQL and HTML are represented through PostgreSQL and HTML5 respectively; authentication appears as Firebase Authentication.
A hard screen for two years of professional React/TypeScript experience could reject this junior profile.
Several missing keywords represent real gaps and should not be added as unsupported skills.
Dublin is outside the job's listed remote countries and may trigger a location screen.

issues: Does not address the gap between the junior profile and the required professional tenure.
Repeats CV evidence effectively but adds limited personal motivation; the supported screen-reader origin story would make it more distinctive.
Mentions 'Privacy by default' without explicitly expressing a willingness to learn health-data privacy requirements.
Does not clarify the remote preference or the unresolved mismatch between Dublin residence and the permitted remote countries.
strengths: Correctly names Verdane Care, the Full-Stack Engineer role and Patient Experience team.
Uses the company's actual 'Privacy by default' principle and patient-facing purpose.
Provides specific accessibility achievements and named testing tools.
Clearly labels full-stack experience as final-year project work rather than professional backend employment.
Includes a portfolio link and avoids the earlier letter's outdated student and internship-application framing.

spacing_issues: The CV's first page is dense while its second page is only 17.4% filled, leaving most of that page empty.
The education section is split across pages; page two opens with the relevant-modules bullet without a repeated section heading.
The teaching-assistant heading and institution run close to the right-aligned date, making that row noticeably tighter than surrounding entries.
issues: The two-page CV is technically acceptable but poorly balanced for a junior candidate; removing repetition and low-value material could likely produce a stronger one-page version.
The letter is clean and readable, with conventional margins and comfortable paragraph spacing.
Both documents use compatible serif typography; the CV's restrained blue accents are professional.

notes_facts_used: Second place at a 2024 student hackathon, with a three-person team building a transit delay notifier in 24 hours; candidate built the frontend.
Teaching assistant for a first-year web-development lab in spring 2025, supporting approximately 30 students for one semester.
Volunteer social-media work for a sea-swimming club.
The absence of professional backend experience is respected by presenting backend work as a final-year project.
notes_facts_ignored: Remote-work preference is not mentioned in either final document.
misused: The teaching-assistant role is assigned to Liffey Institute of Technology even though the notes do not name an institution.

requests.request: Please write my CV first, then the cover letter.
requests.evidence: Both your CV and cover letter are ready; let me know if you’d like any changes.
requests.note: Both requested documents are supplied, with the CV presented first. The shortened conversation does not independently establish the internal generation sequence.

evaluation.summary: These are credible, well-written documents that foreground the candidate's strongest evidence: accessibility fixes, React/TypeScript projects, unit testing and Storybook. They correctly distinguish academic full-stack work from professional backend experience and avoid inflating tenure, although the teaching-assistant institution is unsupported. The main presentation weakness is the poorly balanced two-page CV, whose second page is only 17.4% filled. The application also leaves the seniority gap and the Dublin-versus-permitted-remote-countries issue unresolved, despite a relevant remote preference.

issues: the last page is only 17.4% filled
